deadline.value: Applicants who need a UK visa must apply by 2 August 2027 for a September or October 2027 start. The page gives no earlier funding deadline.
deadline.quote: For research courses that start in September and October 2027, the application deadline for students who require a visa to study in the UK is 2 August 2027.

gre_subject.value: The course page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants choose from existing CDT projects rather than writing a research proposal.
supervisor.quote: The HetSys CDT does not accept research proposals, we recruit to existing projects

funding.value: Every HetSys project comes with a fully funded four-year scholarship, and self-funded students are not admitted.
funding.quote: All HetSys projects come with a fully funded four-year scholarship | There is no opportunity for self-funded students.

entry_route.value: A 2:1 honours degree at BSc/BEng, or an integrated Master's, in a physical science, mathematics or engineering discipline is the minimum.
entry_route.quote: 2:1 honours degree at BSc/BEng or an integrated Master’s (e.g. MPhys, MChem, MSci, MEng etc.)

notes: Centre for Doctoral Training run from the School of Engineering with seven departments. The field is materials and computational modelling.
name: Modelling of Heterogeneous Systems PhD (HetSys CDT)
